brief: Whetstorm art what to replace first, for ChatGPT.docx, 2026-10-26

records.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original Whetstorm title-screen landscape, wide 16:9 PNG. A great round open-air sandstone fighting arena on a rocky island at sunrise, seen from high above one side. Tiered stands filled with a crowd represented by simple grouped marks, warm sand floor with two tiny fighters, a few strong banners, turquoise sea and slate-blue storm sky beyond. Keep the middle third calm and slightly darker for a login box. Original stylized fantasy, hand-painted illustration with bold CLEAN SHAPES and very strong silhouettes, broad color masses and restrained detail, slightly heroic proportions and oversized weapons, warm sunlit sandstone, worn leather and forged steel, a tiny crackling white-blue lightning accent, soft painterly upper-left light. Lush vibrant but coherent colors. This must read as a clean stylized game painting at thumbnail size, NOT photorealistic, NOT a high-detail 3D render, NOT a dense muddy AI panorama. No text, letters, logos, watermark, UI or borders. Original designs, no existing game, film or artist imitation. Keep the main arena architecture simple and physically coherent.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original Whetstorm wide 16:9 title and loading-screen PNG, COAST ROAD. A dusty road winding along a green and gold island coast. Arrange the route clearly from a river ford with sandy wild cattle at left, past a few steaming hot mud pools and yellow gorse hills with smoke from a tiny goblin camp, toward a black burnt heath and a wooden cliff lookout far right. A few very small travelers carry oversized weapons. Middle third calm with broad uninterrupted muted shapes for a login box. Original stylized fantasy HAND-PAINTED LOOK, bold clean broad shapes and strong silhouettes, deliberately simplified terrain, grouped foliage masses, restrained texture; no photorealism or high-fidelity 3D. Warm sunlit sandstone, lush green gorse and grass, worn leather and forged steel, turquoise sea against slate-blue storm skies. Soft upper-left painterly light. Clear readable composition rather than many tiny objects. No text, letters, logos, watermarks, UI or border. Original designs, no imitation of any existing game, film or artist.
